name: Punto de héroe
desc: Foreman's Gear se encuentra en el suelo en Dostoev Sky Peak. Al interactuar con él, aparecen the foreman y su cuadrilla.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Preserved Footprint se encuentra dentro de The Wide Expanse of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. Al interactuar con él se activa el desafío Derrota the ancient jotun spirits desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Dwarven Relic in the Dociu Excavation in the Dredgehaunt Cliffs. It is reached by walking through the dredge tunnels in the southeast corner of the map. Está custodiado por a Veteran Dredge.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Kakkilak se encuentra en Dissun's Mine. The entrance to the cave complex is on the snowy plain in Steelbrachen, not against the mountainside. Interactúa con ella para el desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Jotun Holy Site is a site where the presence of the elder jotun spirits can be felt. Comulgar con él otorga un punto de héroe al jugador.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Shiniest Skritt Treasure is a desafío de héroe located in Ratatosk, a skritt outpost in Dredgehaunt Cliffs. Para conseguir el punto de héroe, hay que comulgar con treasure. Suele estar custodiado por a Veteran Cave Spider y sus esbirros.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: This unique Steam Portal is a permanent portal to a potential future, unattached to a mechanical gate like most other Steam Portals.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Heart of the Priory is a vast collection of levitating, rotating stone tablets.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Dwarven Relic found within Underburg talks about the fate of the dwarves.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Peg Leg is a desafío de héroe NPC located in False Lake.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Grenth's Door is an old statue of Grenth located within an abandoned temple, the Reaper's Gate.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Skillet is a skritt who wants to smash you with his pet Smashy.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Frozen Portal used by an ice imp and ice elementals se encuentra en northern Lornar's Pass. Similar portals are used by the icebrood elsewhere.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Mysterious Meat is a desafío de héroe object located in a Fleshreaver-infested cave in the Durmand Priory area of Lornar's Pass.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Lionguard Mette looks for a sparring partner, providing a desafío de héroe in Stonescatter Wash.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Bjord's Banner stands at the end of a small path atop Svanir's Dome. Triggering the banner will start Derrota Bjord y su cuadrilla.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: An Ancient Cave Spring flows forth in the depths of Warmspring Grotto in Solitude Vale. The path leading to its soothing waters is guarded by several Veteran Cave Spiders that would hinder your progress.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Burrisson the Blue is half-naked norn at The Shadowhorns. Characters must speak to him, then defeat him in combat, to earn a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Bear Shaman Marga is enjoying the simple life in a cave over in Kresdor Kenning. To find her cave, start from the  Grawlenfjord Waypoint —  and follow the river north. The river will then branch to the east into a cave. Swim into the cave, diving under the water where it is blocked and emerging on the other side in the cave.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Some Aging Ale Barrels are maturing in the Lostvyrm Cave, which is located halfway between Dolyak Pass and Hunter's Lake. Lucha contra past the many wurms to sneak a swig and the challenge, though perhaps not the taste, may be rewarding. After taking a sample from the barrel, a Cold Filtered Wurm Tincture will be placed in your inventory. To receive the punto de héroe you must consume this item.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Issormir's Body rests in the snowy arena of Hangrammr Climb, still attesting to the mighty clash that felled it. Comulga con este lugar de poder to complete its desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Corrupted Spike juts out from the ground at a Sons of Svanir encampment near Hunter's Lake. Unleashing its frozen wrath summons forth a Veteran Elder Icebrood Troll and two Icebrood Minions. Destroy them, and the Derrota the elder icebrood troll and his minions desafío de héroe will be complete.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Blane the Insane represents the Sons of Svanir of Hermit's Watch. Players must defeat him to earn a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Cooroo is quaggan at Naui Waters. He is the initiator of the desafío de héroe Lucha contra Cooroo's Crab.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Bullablopp is willing to recount the plights of the quaggans from the Unending Ocean to those who will listen.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Interacting with the Ritual Tribal Paint hidden deep inside Candle Chimney will provide Grawl Paint, an item granting one punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Strange Energy Source is a desafío de héroe located at the The Great Oouo Point of Interest in the Guilty Tears area in Timberline Falls. It is located in a small asuran lab in the shape of a face.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Ural's Delve is a communing desafío de héroe in Ural's Delve.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Frost Portal used by icebrood se encuentra en Drakkar Spurs. Similar portals are used by the icebrood elsewhere.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Shaman Okamuk starts the Derrota Okamuk desafío de héroe in Despond Precipice.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Flowing Ice is a kodan found in Talabaroop Waves, on the east side of the track that rings the ship, up a staircase. Derrota him in order to earn a Hero point.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Miner Voss is a dredge eager to learn the ways of fighting of the other races. He is found slightly north of the Groznev Waypoint, after walking down the ramp from the, turning west, and heading through the tunnel.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Eulda Soulseer is a desafío de héroe NPC found in Yakkington's Toil.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Commune with the Glacial Trench is a desafío de héroe located in a cavern in Watchful Fjord. Simply swim to the bottom of the ocean floor to reach this punto de héroe. There are three poisonous urchins that should be cleared out before you attempt to commune with the point, or else they will interrupt you.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Talooboo is a quaggan in Talabaroop Waves that is confident in the strength of the shark he has trained. Talk to Talooboo to fight the shark and earn a punto de héroe, .

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Razorwing's Nest is fiercely guarded in the western reach of Snowden Drifts. Provocation will result in Razorwing and three of her griffon brood to attack. Fend off the attack and the Hero challenge will be completed.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Grawl Totem of Glisterice Caves hovers above a small grawl encampment in Snowden Drifts.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Stinging Wind is waiting north of Lost Child's Sorrow Waypoint. Speak with him to begin his challenge to earn a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Devotee of Owl is one of the last followers of the deceased spirit of Owl found at Owl's Abattoir.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Corvin the Skaald is a skaald offering a riddle to adventurers. As a child, he was saved by Eir Stegalkin and brought to Hoelbrak, saving his life and leading him to become a great skaald.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Raven Shaman's Power Source is carefully tucked away in an upper cavern of Darkhoof Heights. The entrance is to the west side of the centaur village (see map in the side bar). The event Slay the evil Raven shaman, Vilnia Shadowsong, and her helper must be completed to access the punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Ethereal Vanguard Monument stands quiet beneath an outcropping in Devast District. Awakening its power summons Captain Mattox and three Ethereal Vanguard soldiers back to be battled. Derrota Captain Mattox and the punto de héroe will be granted.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Centurion Micka Thickblood is a member of the Blood Legion that challenges players to a fight when they interact with her. Derrota her to earn a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The submerged Ruins of Ascalon City rest deep in the lake. A Veteran Bog Skale might have taken to its stony remains, but the site's latent energies remain a tempting reward for adventurers in the area.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Centurion Titus Gearclaw is looking for a sparring partner in Tela Range. Best him in some friendly combat to complete his desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Ascalonian Ruins can be found deep into the ghost infested area. Several Veteran ghosts guard the way to it.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: An Effigy Core is left within a guarded cave near Lake Adorea to draw adventurers to help test a new Veteran Prototype Effigy.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A large Searing Crystal, worshiped by nearby grawl as the Tail of the Star God remains as a testament to the Searing.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Tucked into a small cave, the Birthplace of the Vigil marks the location of Almorra's Massacre. Contemplate over the defining event to complete this desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Fane Skinchisel is a charr sentinel stationed at the sentinel camp near Brandview Waypoint in the Blazeridge Mountains. Players who don't back down from a sparring bout and prove their worth will complete her desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The remnants of a campfire in Heretic Plain warns of danger in the area. Derrota the Marmox Packleader and his pack to pacify the area and complete this desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: In the center of the Wreckage of Serenity stand the ruins of Serenity Temple. Though destroyed hundreds of years ago in the Searing, the intrepid adventurer can channel the hallowed legacy and complete this desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Krunko Bugtender is an ogre found in Hautclaire Vale. Entering her proximity will initiate the Derrota Krunko Bugtender desafío de héroe .

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Gwen's Grave is the gravestone of Gwen Thackeray and a Hero Challenge in the Stronghold of Ebonhawke. It is located in the memorial at the top of the Defender's Field cemetery. Her headstone is flanked on both sides by Memorial Plaques. It can be used as a place of power for charging Quartz Crystal.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Scrabclaw's Roost is the home of Veteran Matriarch Scrabclaw and her flock.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Fallen Angel Gretel is a member of the Fallen Angels stationed in the Stronghold of Ebonhawke and a desafío de héroe NPC who offers to spar with the player.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: This Pile of Stones is the grave of the sylvari, Killeen.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Flame Core is a desafío de héroe object located in Keeper's Sanctum. Players interacting with this object will start the Derrota Smolderjaw and His Warband event.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Burning Forest is a Hero Challenge located in Simurgh Timberland. Players will need to overcome various flaming creatures to commune with this volcanic vent.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Chieftain Inpetla is the start NPC for the Derrota Chieftain Inpetla desafío de héroe in the Rustbowl.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Tribune Sorya Fatekiller is an Ash Legion Tribune in charge of Ash forces in Fireheart Rise fighting the Flame Legion.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Steelbeak's Nest is found in the Fuller Cistern.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Marse Scythetail is a member of the Order of Whispers located in Liberation Dell who has heard about the player's character and wishes to spar with them. Derrotaing him will award a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Flame Castrum is a desafío de héroe located in Sloven Pitch. Communing with the volcanic vent awards players with a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Imp Power Essence is a stone that is tied to Emberclaw.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Zzzig is an ogre found in Lamprey Grottoes that, as a means of staying awake, challenges the player to a duel. Derrota him to earn a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Sharky Longears is a golemancer who starts the desafío de héroe Derrota Sharky Longears and Thundernation P70X near Lake Carnifex.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Crusader Arevir Soulhammer is a member of the Vigil that quizzes people about General Almorra Soulkeeper. Answer her correctly to earn a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Searing Cauldrons were the tools used by the charr led by Flame Legion to bring forth the Searing in 1070 AE.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Branded Waterfall resides to the north of Lake Desolann, feeding the lake with corrupted water.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Warning: Bogfang the Skale sign can be found on the larger of two small islands in northern Blackblade Lake. Interacting with it will spawn Bogfang.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Roj the Rowdy Butcher resides in the The Blasted Moors. Derrota him in combat to complete his challenge.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Rancher-in-Training Poisonswill is a charr cub and rancher in training. He has an apple-loving pet bull of which he might be over-confident of in its abilities.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Veruta Beefhawker is a strange charr hiding in an isolated cave who offers players her Tasty Meat which, upon consuming the item, will grant a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Ascalonian Aqueduct is a desafío de héroe in The Blasted Moors. The blood-borne energies reside within the Old Grendich Aqueduct, beneath the Grendich Ruins. Though now hidden away below the ground, empty wells and lakeside passages still allow access to these older ruins. It can be used as a place of power for charging Quartz Crystals.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Sharptail's Nest is found high in the devourer-filled Gram Hills. Disturbing the nest will summon Veteran Sharptail and two of her brood to attack. Derrota them to rise to the challenge.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Shaman Purda is a norn shaman of the Snow Leopard. She se encuentra en Charrgate Haven in the Halrunting Plains and defeating her earns the player a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Remains of the Northern Wall are part of the Northern Wall which once stood in defense of Ascalon from the charr horde. Thrust high in the air, its remnant energies shine in grim reminder as ghosts of Ascalon's fallen now wander in the ruins.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Ancient Sentry of Balthazar Statue is a desafío de héroe veteran battle in Triumph Plaza.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Statue of Lyssa se encuentra en the northwest corner of Elysium Beach. Depending on whether Zhaitan controls the Temple of Balthazar, the foes encountered may be elementals or risen.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: This Statue of Balthazar is found at the altar of the Cathedral of Glorious Victory. It is difficult to reach when the area is controlled by risen due to the firestorms razing the area.
wiki: Statue of Balthazar (Cathedral of Glorious Victory)

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Grenth's Graveyard is a communing desafío de héroe in The Bloodtrough. Approaching it from the west provides a smaller number of enemies to defeat before being able to commune.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Priory Magister looks for a sparring partner, providing a desafío de héroe in Fort Trinity.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Veteran Risen Spectral Guard starts a desafío de héroe in the Cathedral of Glorious Victory.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Two books se encuentra en The Vizier's Tower, both of which are the journals of a researcher who had climbed the tower to study Vizier Khilbron.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Vigil Tactician is looking for a sparring partner in Triumph Plaza, providing a desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Lost Conservatory is a communing desafío de héroe in Strait of Sacrilege.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Sunken Ship is a communing desafío de héroe in Strait of Sacrilege.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Statue of Melandru is a communing type desafío de héroe located on the edge of The Royal Forum, deep beneath the ocean surface. Spirits of Sorrow watch over the statue while the statue is untainted by Zhaitan's influence.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Statue of Dwayna is encountered en-route to the Pact Rally Point on the southern invasion path.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Statue of Grenth is located at the altar in the Cathedral of Silence. It is a commune type desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Statue of Melandru is a communing type desafío de héroe encountered in the Cathedral of Verdance.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Gallow's Hang is a place of power desafío de héroe nearby the Point of Interest of the same name.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Spectral Hammer is an Orrian hammer lying on the ground in an old beached and rotting ship within Desmina's Hallows. Interacting with it causes it to come to life, and upon defeating it will award a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Plaque of Ewan lies in the center of Village of Ewan, commemorating the village.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Explorer Brothmirr Rockslide is a member of the Durmand Priory willing to duel nearby adventurers.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Harbinger Torch is a communing desafío de héroe in Graven Cay.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Pristine Chest is found in the depths of The Shipyard. It contains Sunken Rations. Consuming these gives a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Captain's Log is a desafío de héroe found submerged within The Wreck of the Golden Vanity in the depths of the Harrowed Sea. Reading it gives a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: An Inscribed Casket resides within the Orrian royal tombs for one of the ancient heroic kings, though the name of the king is unknown.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Strange Ring Structures lie embedded in the northern coast of the Cursed Shore.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Mysterious Egg is a desafío de héroe at the southernmost edge of the Mausollus Sea, Cursed Shore.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Pixi is a desafío de héroe NPC in Cursed Shore, by Sharn's Free Camp.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Fortuna Dirgecaller is a desafío de héroe found within Meddler's Summit in Compass Plaza.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Spectral Sword is an Orrian sword found lying on the ground in the labyrinth within Winterknell Isle. Interacting with it causes it to come to life, and upon defeating it will award a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Statue of Balthazar se encuentra en the northwest corner of the Fields of Gold, looking south towards the gladiator's arena. It is a commune type desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Statue of Melandru is a communing type desafío de héroe encountered in the center of Graven Cay, dedicated to the goddess Melandru.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: King's Altar is an altar dedicated to the kings of Orr. It is situated underground in the King's Passage, north of Doric's Waypoint.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Altar of Dwayna is the altar of the Cathedral of Zephyrs, also known as the Altar of Tempests.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Enchanted Orrian Bow is lying on the ground near to the Bayt Fallahin point of interest in the Garden of Ilya.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Altar of Lyssa is the altar of the Cathedral of Eternal Radiance, also known as the Altar of Lies.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Explorer Cinnia is a Durmand Priory explorer who has begun studying Orrian lore. Talking to her will award a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Metal Forest is a desafío de héroe in the Wealdwood on the Pyrite Peninsula. The forest was turned to gold by an ancient and mysterious golden orb of light. The properties of the orb are completely unknown, and an interest to both the Pact and the Inquest.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Alexandra Duet is a Pact member in Augur's Grotto that challenges adventurers to a duel in return for a punto de héroe if she is defeated. Her quotes and attacks identify her as an Order of Whispers member and a mesmer.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Memory of Dhuum's Last Stand is the location where Grenth overthrew Dhuum, the former God of Death, with the aid of the Seven Heroes. It is located in the ossuary of the Cathedral of Eternal Radiance.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: An Old Jar lies next to the broken, skeletal remains of a ship. Interacting with it gives an Unidentified Beverage.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Looah is a Hero challenge NPC found at Snaketail Inlet, who gives a punto de héroe upon being defeated.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Statue of Dwayna is found along the southern edge of the Karst Plains. It is a commune type desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Statue of Grenth overlooks the water in the southwest of the Drowned Brine. It is a commune type desafío de héroe with several risen foes, including a veteran, nearby.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Statue of Melandru is a communing type desafío de héroe located beneath the overhang of Sculptor's End just below the surface of Whisper Bay. There is a diving location directly above it. It will become corrupted if the Cathedral of Zephyrs becomes contested or is under Zhaitan's control.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Statue of Lyssa can be found on the northern slopes of the Blighted Arch, looking out to sea. Depending on whether Zhaitan controls the Cathedral of Eternal Radiance, the foes encountered may be elementals or risen.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Statue of Balthazar can be found on the road between Pagga's Camp and the Village of Wren. It is a commune type desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The submerged ruins of the Temple of the Ages rest in the water of Godslost Swamp. A Veteran Marsh Drake may have taken to its stony remains, but the site's latent energies remain a tempting reward for adventurers in the area.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Erts Jug of Power Unguent[sic] sits in Veteran Ert and Burt's cave at the head of Pinion Trail. If one can tire Ert out, a sample of Ert's Unguent from the jar is an... interesting, if foul, reward. The unguent is placed into your inventory after interacting with the desafío de héroe and the punto de héroe is received when it is consumed, which can be done at any time. The use of the unguent also provides a green tint to your character for some time.[verification requested]

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The swirling energies of the Tamini Place of Power are a grim reminder of centaur cruelty in southeast Queensdale. Take justice to the Veteran Tamini Chieftain and his accompanying centaur horde—only then can an adventurer hear its cries in peace.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Bandit Loot can be found tucked at the base of a tree in Altar Brook Vale. Franklin Quickblade and two of his friends won't let it go without a fight.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Chhk the Windmill King is a confused skritt who believes himself the "Windmill King". Derrota him to earn a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A remnant pillar of Earthen Magic floats in the center of Scaver Plateau, marking the blasted site of a previous battle. Comulga con este lugar de poder and complete its desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Carnie Jeb mans a tent at the Beetletun carnival grounds in Queensdale. Step right up and win a battle to complete his Hero challenge to earn a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Hidden Falls is a communing style desafío de héroe in Bonerattler Caverns.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Dolyak's Rest is an ancient place where Old Dolyaks go to die, leaving carcasses and bones to litter the area around it.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Craig Sensay provides a desafío de héroe in Wildspine Hills. After talking to him, you must destroy the nearby ballista.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Ancient War Stones are magic stones tied to the Warbeasts. Interacting with it triggers a desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Harathi Forward Post lies across the bridge from Seraph's Landing, among ruined buildings. Comulga con este lugar de poder to complete its desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Conspicuous Feather Pile is a desafío de héroe located in Greenflin Plateau, north of the Seraph camp.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Centaur Gathering Site is embedded in the heart of Meremoot Hill. Its energies are guarded by hostile centaurs; only after they are defeated can someone tap into its power.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Tocatl awaits on Viathan's Arm above the Eukaryan Caves, to give Ol' Stinky a test run.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Master Elementalist Dylane starts the Hero challenge Derrota Merkessa the Fire Elemental.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Enchanted Meat Rack is set in the back of Draithor's Demesnes. Its strange contents are guarded by a Veteran Draithor's Wurm; killing the wurm will allow the character to obtain Draithor's Lab's Powerfully Weird Meat off the rack.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Eternal Portal is a desafío de héroe found in Blackroot Cut. The portal to the Underworld gapes large in the narrow eastern alcove of the swamp, and listening to its whispers will spawn an Aatxe and a pair of Shades to defeat.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Softly Glowing Light floats in a cave in the eastern mountains of Gendarran Fields. Its refreshing qualities have attracted Ettins that must be dealt with before reaching its power.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Klakka the Brain is on a half-sunken ship in the southern Brigantine Isles with Jaxx the Ram and Sunshine. She's either looking for a fight or some fun—show her your moves and complete her Hero challenge.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Ooze Analyzer XH-9333 has been brewing something special in the ooze-populated waters of the upper Hezran Outcrops. Lucha contra or run through the Veteran Translucent Oozes around the falls to acquire a taste of the Prototype Ooze Concentrate Tincture and complete the Hero challenge.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Willoo is a quaggan in Lake Gendarr trying to rage. Helping Willoo do so and defeating him will award a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Warmaster Yulia has been following your legend. Test your strength against her to complete the Hero challenge.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Ancient Cave Spring is a communing desafío de héroe hidden within Melandru's Cenote in Stonebore Vaults, and is guarded by a Veteran Cave Spider.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A brightly-colored Oakheart Seed has taken root on the hills of the Talajian Piedmont. Choosing to undertake its challenge will summon forth a Veteran Ancient Oakheart and two Oakheart Saplings.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Derrota the River Drake Broodmother is a level 50 desafío de héroe in Mentecki Pass. It is triggered by approaching the River Drake Hatchlings when the character has not earned this punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Deputy Crackshot is a member of the Lionguard at Stormbluff Beacon. She gives the desafío de héroe to hit 3 targets with her cannons.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Beckoning Force is a pool of water imbued with magic. It is located inside, at the bottom of one of the crashed pirate ships. The stairways leading to the pool of water blend in with their backgrounds and environment; thus, it's tricky to see at first glance. It may only be reached once the gates are opened during the The Campaign Against Taidha Covington event, which starts once every 3 hours.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Agent Xinn is a desafío de héroe NPC in northeast Stormbluff Isle. She is waiting in the cave entrance to the Chantry of Secrets near Deadend Waypoint. Derrota her to earn a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Krait Place of Power can be found deep within the Flooded Castavall.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Two-Eye Ignatl is a hylek pirate in Mournful Depths that challenges passersby to a duel, awarding a punto de héroe. See Derrota Two-Eye Ignatl the Pirate for the desafío de héroe event.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: This Waterfall in Ogham Wilds is a place of importance to the sylvari, being similar to a place in the Dream of Dreams.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Krait Altar desafío de héroe can be found underwater beneath Slaver's Deeps in northern Quetzal Bay, where the krait sacrifice slaves as a ritual to their prophets.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Morgan's Orchid is an unusual plant found in Morgan's Spiral with beautiful blossoms used to obtain a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Swift Arrow is a tengu looking to pass on his knowledge of battle to travelers passing by the door to the  Dominion of Winds in Caledon Forest. Derrota him to gain in his knowledge, and complete the desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Mysterious Patch of Ground is in Glencarn Sperrins, north-east of Brigid's Overlook Waypoint. It is the trigger for Derrota the Veteran Ancient Maguuma Wurm and Its Hatchlings desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Powerful Darkness se encuentra cerca de Banshee's Keen hiding some Nightmare Courtiers in Wychmire Swamp. It triggers Derrota the Knight of Sorrows and Her Attendants.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Dark Thorn Patch se encuentra dentro de the Briarthorn Den of Morgan's Spiral. Al interactuar con él se activa el desafío Derrota the Thorn Wolf Scariel and Its Pack desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Black Ice 4444 is an Inquest holographic training golem found in the Inquest Outer Complex.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Councillor Oola was a brilliant asura who specialised in creating constructs—humanoid magical creations, of which golems are but one.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Cuatl Health Goo is a container within Cuatl Morass that holds Cuatl Tonics.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Suspicious Control Panel is a desafío de héroe object found in Michoan Marsh that, upon interacting with it, starts Derrota Golemancer Gitt and His Prototype Golems.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Ancient Elemental Fire Energy can be found outside the north-east of the Thaumanova Reactor complex. When interacted with, it spawns one Veteran Ancient Ember and two Ancient Ember Minions.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Arcanic Interferometer is a asuran control console. Interacting with this object begins the desafío de héroe Derrota Master Genius Jettz and His Assistants.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Luminates Plant is the core and generators of the actual power plant in Metrica Province. It is not obvious how to get to this desafío de héroe. It cannot be reached from the top floor of the plant, where the main entrance and stair leads. Instead, take the lower northwest entrance, located northeast of the road intersection and directly south of the Hexane Regrade renown heart. The desafío de héroe is at the end of a long corridor, guarded by a Veteran Air Elemental.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Utcua is a hylek warrior of the Durotl tribe in Loch Jezt.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Lady Grimassi is a human that players can talk to in order to receive a Toxal Bog Stew, which, when consumed, will grant players a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Henge of Denravi is a communing desafío de héroe in Brisban Wildlands.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Seraph Soldier Michella patrols the Koga Ruins.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Derrotaing a Restless Arboreal Spirit is the objective of a desafío de héroe in Hidden Lake.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Thaumacore Energy Source is a desafío de héroe located in the Duskstruck Moors.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Super Shiny Thing is an object that belongs to a king skritt. Interacting with it will start the Derrota Schotakk the Shiny King and His Band event.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Keg of Skrittsburgh Special se encuentra en Skrittsburgh, providing a Bottle of Skrittsburgh Special to those curious enough to try it.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Inventor Shminkta is a skritt with a power suit.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: IQ1800 LX is a semi-transparent, malfunctioning holographic golem found in the Zone Green of the Infinite Coil Reactor area of Mount Maelstrom, which rewards a punto de héroe for defeating it.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Petil is one of the fiercest warrior of the Tzanopl Grounds.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Urrahn The Hunter is a powerful largos hunter who dwells in an underwater volcanic cave beneath an island in Mount Maelstrom. He is very secretive beyond wanting to test the player's skills. He has a desafío de héroe Derrota Urrahn the Hunter.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Tarkkakt is a skritt on the shore of the the Mire Sea.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Heart of the Volcano is a desafío de héroe located in the center of Maelstrom's Bile.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Droknah's Relic is a communion punto de héroe located at the Sunken Droknah.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Scribbles in the Dirt se encuentra en the southwest corner of Mount Maelstrom, at Murkvale. Interacting with it will begin the desafío de héroe Derrota Venomspinner and her devourer brood.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Veteran Hylek Chief is a hylek found inside the Uzanarin Depths.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Ancient Energy Source is a communing desafío de héroe within a spider-infested cave in Saltflood Mire, located south and west of Saltflood Waypoint in water beneath tree roots.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Gilbert's Treasure Map is found in southern Aleem's Penance. Taking this map will result in attack of the ghosts of Captain Gilbert and two Gilbert's Crew. Fend off their attack and the desafío de héroe will be completed.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Orrian Tomb lies in ruin at the bottom of the lake in Leeshore Gauntlet.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Spooky Luka the Disbeliever offers a punto de héroe challenge. She does not aggro until the challenge dialogue is completed, so the two or three Ghostly Pirate Lucha contraers in her vicinity can be dispatched at leisure. Luka herself is no harder than an ordinary Veteran Ghostly Pirate Lucha contraer.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Ancient Shark Pistrix's corpse se encuentra en an underwater cave just northwest of the Shrine of Usharr. The entrance to the cave is found in a pool of water to the southeast of the skill challenge icon. Simply interacting with Pistrix's corpse will complete the Hero challenge.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: In a cave beneath the Central Advance Camp, aggressive mushrooms line the rocky interior and attack any trespassers. Enter towards the south and glide in above the lethal vines that line the bottom of the map to commune with this desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A Spider Nest se encuentra en Wyvern Scar, guarded by spiders drawn to its ley-energy.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Near the north lane in Dragon's Stand is an abandoned set of Exalted ruins that has been overtaken by the jungle. A pylon still stands among the ruins, however, full of power. Communing with this place of power will net the player 10 punto de héroes.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Stavemaster Adryn's Pod is the Blighting Tree pod that creates new bodies for Legendary Stavemaster Adryn to be reborn in.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Blademaster Diarmid's Pod is the Blighting Tree pod that creates new bodies for Legendary Blademaster Diarmid to be reborn in.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Axemaster Hareth's Pod is the Blighting Tree pod that creates new bodies for Legendary Axemaster Hareth to be reborn in.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Dragon Overlook is the Hero Challenge located near Serenity's Cove in Dragon's Stand.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Balthazar's Statue is an overgrown statue of Balthazar located in the long-abandoned temple known as Balthazar's Rest.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Notice to Trespassers is located in a small Quetzal village above the jungle floor that can be accessed by heading north from Eastwatch Waypoint and jumping up the mushroom-cliff path. The village is guarded by several Veteran Quetzal Warriors and Veteran Quetzal Scouts. Interacting with the Notice will trigger a group event that spawns Champion Commander Razorwing along with two Veteran Razorwing Guards. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: High in the cliffs of Burnisher Quarry is a collection of energy with which the player can commune to complete this desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: On the ground floor of the jungle in the heart of the Arrowhead Vale is a Suspicious Orichalcum Node. Interacting with it allows you to start the event Derrota the champion arrowhead. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Exalted Overlook is a desafío de héroe in Auric Basin. You can reach it by gliding down from the Northgate of Tarir, the Forgotten City.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Champion Tarnished Sage is found at the beginning of the trial rooms beneath Tarir, the Forgotten City, opposite the Tarnished Traitor. To reach him, hop down into the hole by the Forgotten City Waypoint. After this challenge has been completed for the first time, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: At the jungle's floor in Tarnished Treetop, a group of Young Mushrooms lays out in the open, waiting for so much as a poke from adventurers. Upon interaction, a Champion Mushroom King will spawn from the mushrooms, and the defeat the mushroom king event will start. Complete the event within 10 minutes to obtain 10 punto de héroes. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Up in the cliff's face, in a small cave, a Mordrem Flower rests among a small group of Mordrem Bombers. Interaction with the flower will trigger the group event Derrota the vinetooth. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Away in a cave, this Egg Clutch rests, waiting for any unwary adventurers to try and grab them. Interaction will trigger a group event in which the Champion Chak Lobber and her two brood members must be killed within 10 minutes to receive the punto de héroes. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Toxin-Cured Hog is an object found in a cave west of Westwatch Patch. If Westwatch has not yet been powered up, then vines will block the path towards the cave from the south. It is however possible to drop down into the cave from the north - players can either glide south from the  Wanderer's Waypoint — , or walk northeast from Westwatch and circle back westwards, before dropping in above the hog. Interaction with the hog will replace all the character's skills and take away any passive effects.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: An Ancient Golem Part rests high in the cliffs of Auric Basin awaiting unwary explorers. Interaction with the part triggers the group event: Derrota the ancient golem recovery squad. This event spawns at least three golems that must be killed within 10 minutes for the punto de héroes. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Within the caves of Tangled Depths grows a small Nightthistle Bloom which awaits challengers. Interaction with the bloom will trigger the group event   Kill the Mordrem champion (80). It spawns a random Mordrem Guard champion who then spawns two random, normal Mordrem Guard who also attack challengers. Derrota the champion within five minutes to complete the challenge. You can interact with the bloom as many times as you want, respawning a random champion and killing it to complete the event. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Hidden away in a cave guarded by many aggressive mushroom named foes stand a proud couple of royalty, a Veteran Mushroom King and a Veteran Mushroom Queen who seem to guard this spore cloud. Kill them and commune with this point to complete the desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The center of the Chak Hatchery is full of ley-energy that fosters the newborn Chak. To enter, use the Nuhoch Wallow at the end of the Nuhoch Lane or swim through the underwater tunnels, exiting in the northwest.  Lucha contra or run through chak that guard the hatchery to commune with this point in the center of the cave to complete the desafío de héroe. Itzel Poison Lore must be trained to survive the cave as it is full of poisonous clouds which kill players within seconds otherwise. The group event Kill the enraged chak overlord spawns in the center of the cave around the point. If alive and in combat, commune may be difficult. It is perhaps easier/recommended to approach cautiously opposite the champion without pulling aggro, allowing the challenge to be completed without killing the champ.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Feeding off the ley energy in the Ogre Lane, a small Egg Clutch waits for travelers to disturb it. Interaction with this clutch will trigger a group event which spawns a Champion Chak Blitzer and two normal Chak which must be killed within 10 minutes to complete the challenge.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Ancient Power Core is the base of a large machine found in the abandoned lab from the personal story. The lab can be accessed by swimming from Rata Novus Waypoint. Exalted Markings is required to make it through the underwater tunnel.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Guano-Incubated Spider Eggs can be found high in the darkness of the Deeproot Sink caves. Unbeknownst to adventurers, a dark alliance has been formed between the Cave Spiders and Vampire Beasts of the cave. Interacting with the eggs will begin the associated desafío de héroe event.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Champion Wayward Troll is a powerful Cave Troll leading his brethren living in the labyrinthian cave system located in the Tangled Descent. He must be defeated to complete the Troll Runestone desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Inquisitor's Campsite can be found up a small ramp north of the Teku Nuhoch outpost, in an aggressive Zintl hylek camp. Al interactuar con él se activa el desafío Hero challenge group event Derrota the Zintl inquisitor, which spawns Champion Zintl Inquisitor and two normal warriors that must be killed within the 10 minute time limit for the challenge's completion. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: In the mushroom cave of Rata Novus, in a small rocky cave are a cluster of Newborn Mushrooms. Interaction with them will trigger the group event Derrota the Champion Mushroom Queen which must be completed within 10 minutes to complete the desafío de héroe. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Deep in the murky, water-filled tunnels underneath Tangled Depths await many aggressive fish and creatures for unwary adventurers. Players can carry an Exalted Beacon crystal through the water to inflict Fear upon aggressive creatures who come too close and make themselves immune to the piranha infested water. Commune with the Jellyfish Grotto at the tunnel's deepest point to complete the challenge.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: High in the cliffs of Tangled Depths, a beautiful waterfall fuels the jungle's waters below. At its top is a commune point that will complete the Gilded River desafío de héroe upon interaction.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: An Ancient Tree is slowly being torn apart by the ravages of the Elder Dragon, the core rotting and falling apart. Deep in the core of the tree, Coztic Bladedancers and Coztic Shadowleapers wait for the intrepid adventurer, harbingers of Mordremoth's all-consuming creep through the jungle. Witness the destruction of nature to complete this desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Ancient Lucha contraing Pit Hero Challenge is perched high above The Waking Tomb.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: At the bottom of the Creeping Crevasse, this Nightthistle Blossom awaits any challengers. Upon triggering the Hero Challenge, a Group Event will spawn one veteran Mordrem and four normal Mordrem. All must be killed within 10 minutes to obtain 10 Hero Points. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Wyvern Nesting Grounds is a commune desafío de héroe in Wyvern Cliffs.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Cliffside Ruins Hero Challenge in Broken Bluffs offers a view of the Precarious Ruin in The Doomteeth.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: On a small ledge at the very bottom of the map in Thistlevine Ravine, this Abyssal Depths is a gathering of Mordremoth's energy simply waiting to be used. Comulga con este lugar de poder to complete the desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: On a small ledge carved into the cliff's face is a small Nuhoch outpost filled with Nuhoch Alchemical Energy. This place of power awaits any experienced adventurers to commune with it to earn 10 punto de héroes. To reach it, from the Pact Encampment Waypoint head east, and then use the Nuhoch Wallows to traverse down to the ledge where you will find a simple communing desafío de héroe. Alternatively, drop off the edge of the cliff from above and glide down onto the ledge.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Pact Airship Wreckage can be found scattered in the Canopy over Noble Crash Site.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Security Console is in the Canopy over Ordnance Corps, northwest of Faren's Flyer Waypoint. It is the trigger for Derrota the Mark I Golem desafío de héroe. Note the golem is a champion and the event spawns Heal-o-Tron mobs, making it difficult to solo. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Pile of Guano is a large pile of bat guano found in the Canopy over Pact Encampment, west of Last Leap Point of Interest. It is the trigger for Derrota the vampire beasts desafío de héroe. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Coztic Itzel Belongings is near the portal to Auric Basin from Verdant Brink, North-East of Treacherous Paths Waypoint. It is the trigger for Derrota the Coztic Itzel homesteaders desafío de héroe. After this challenge has been completed for punto de héroes, it can then be activated and completed daily for map currency, experience and additional rewards.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Ley Line Hub is a desafío de héroe located in the far east of the Cavern of the Shining Lights in Dry Top.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Mending Waters is a desafío de héroe located in the Uplands Oasis area in Dry Top, at the top of the waterfall. The Mending Waters effect is present at the bottom of the waterfall, healing players who take fall damage.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Wreckage of Zephyrite Crystal Garden is a desafío de héroe located in the Prospect Valley area of Dry Top.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Hruugar Ironhaunch is a centaur meditating in a cave near Restoration Refuge. Talking to him in his grove will begin a desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Cliff Peak is a desafío de héroe located on the eastern edge of Challenger Cliffs. Players must make use of an air Aspect crystal in order to reach it.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Strange Pillar is a desafío de héroe located in Central Silverwastes.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Fragrant Cactus is a punto de héroe challenge located in Desperate Passage. Interacting with it rewards a Fragrant Cactus Fruit, which can be consumed to gain a punto de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Veteran Northern Shelf Elemental is a powerful Dust Mite Twister found in Northeastern Silverwastes that players can challenge to gain a Hero point.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Sacred Stones is a desafío de héroe located in the Far Silverwastes.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Skritt Ledge is a desafío de héroe located in the skritt caves below Northeastern Silverwastes.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Fallen Asura is a desafío de héroe in Vinewrath Tangle. Interacting with it rewards a Mysterious Elixir, which can be consumed at any time to gain a punto de héroe. This challenge is normally only accessible during Time Out (meta event), following successful completion of Mordrem Vinewrath. However, a Springer can jump over the vines blocking entry to the room.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Quarry Overlook is a communing punto de héroe located on a balcony overlooking Residential District of the Xunlai Jade Quarry.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Quarry Platform is a communing punto de héroe located near Miner's Folly in the Flooded Basin.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Hatchery Play Pond is a communing punto de héroe located in the Juno Hatchery.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Harvest Complex Pavilion is a communing punto de héroe located near the Harvest Temple.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Roaring Waterfall is a communing desafío de héroe above The Green Grotto in Archipelagos Rim.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Harvest Temple Main Entrance is a communing punto de héroe located near the Harvest Temple.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Tsuko Talonedge is a Kestrel trainer found in the training area in Arborstone. She can be fought after the Base of Operations mastery is upgraded.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Engineer Hu is a Xunlai Jade technician working in Baedal Hill he is also a repeatable desafío de héroe.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Veteran Purist Necromancer is a repeatable desafío de héroe in Grub Lane.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Old Kaineng Ruins is a communing desafío de héroe in Old Kaineng. Está custodiado por a random elite Unchained Risen. This may be an Elite Unchained Acolyte, Devastator, Mage, or Sentinel.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Ministry of Archives is a communing desafío de héroe in Soojung Heights. Está custodiado por a random elite Purist.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Jade Monument is a desafío de héroe located in the Power Plant area of New Kaineng City, overlooking the Jade Monument.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The New Kaineng City Limits is a desafío de héroe located in the Petrified Woods area of New Kaineng City. Está custodiado por a random elite Speaker.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Lab District Terrace is a communing desafío de héroe in North Lab. Está custodiado por a random Elite Jade Brotherhood member.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Garden Scaffolding is a communing desafío de héroe in Bori Ward.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Sotdae Landing Lookout is a communing desafío de héroe in Sotdae Landing. It is near the top of a building structure.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Veteran Jade Bulwark is a repeatable desafío de héroe on the Training Grounds in Seitung Province.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Old Bell Shrine is found in Haiju Plains, over the bridge directly south of Haiju Docks Waypoint. It is the trigger for Derrota the Kirin desafío de héroe that is repeatable.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Cliffside Memorial Bell is a desafío de héroe in Zen Daijun. It's located east of the  Spirit Vestibule — , guarded by several Speaker Ritualists and a random elite Speaker.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Bloom of Seitung is a communing desafío de héroe within Seitung Harbor underneath a tree.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Village Overlook is a communing desafío de héroe in Eastern Wilds. It is at the top of a rocky spire.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Village Overlook is a communing desafío de héroe in Shing Jea Monastery. It's located east of the  Monastery Temple.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Dog Statue is a communing desafío de héroe in Shinota Shore. It's located north of the  Shrine of Reverence. Está custodiado por several Aetherblade including a random elite.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Haiju Hatchery is a communing desafío de héroe in Shinota Shore. It can be reached by diving in the basin of Fish Hatchery.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Source of the Springs is a communing desafío de héroe in Shinota Shore.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Submerged Cathedral is a communing desafío de héroe in Lake Lutgardis.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: House zu Heltzer is a communing desafío de héroe in Zu Heltzer Historical Site.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Speaker Headquarters is a communing desafío de héroe in Warden's Folly.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Gravestone of Lord Archek Brauer is a communing desafío de héroe in Zu Heltzer Historical Site. It's located in the back of the graveyard and does not require a mount to reach.  Está custodiado por one of the following elites - Elite Unbound Spirit of Pain, Elite Canthan Spirit Archer, Elite Canthan Spirit Tahkayun, Elite Unbound Spirit of Destruction, Elite Unbound Spirit of Agony or Elite Canthan Spirit Swordsman.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Village Overlook is a communing desafío de héroe in Mori Village. It's located in above the buildings of the top floor of the village and can be reached using a mount.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Xunlai Jade Junkyard Overlook is a communing desafío de héroe above the Xunlai Jade Junkyard. Está custodiado por an Elite Brotherhood Scrapper, Elite Brotherhood Sharpshooter, Elite Brotherhood Pistoleer or Elite Brotherhood Junker.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: A saurian nest with golem parts in it can be found on a high ledge in south Skyshroud Canopy. Interacting with it summons an Elite Tyrannus Man-Eater. Mesmers can reveal the illusion cast on the nest, exposing the Suspicious Egg.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Raging Waterfall is a place of power—a communing type desafío de héroe in The Winding Passage, hidden behind a waterfall.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Cave Overlook is a place of power—a communing type desafío de héroe in Shimmering Basin, east of the Foothold Bivouac Waypoint.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Serene Lily Pad is a place of power—a communing type desafío de héroe in Skyshroud Canopy, it is located to the west of the Lake of Lillies Point of Interest. It sits on top of a large lily pad on the lake.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: Ley-Rich Roots is a place of power—a communing type desafío de héroe in Overgrown Thicket. It is nestled in between above-ground tree roots entwined around huge magic orbs.

name: Punto de héroe
desc: The Glider's Ledge is a place of power—a communing type desafío de héroe in Cloister of Stars. It is located on a ledge west of the Priory Expedition Waypoint and can easiest be accessed by jumping on the nearby bouncing mushroom.

name: Punto de héroe
